rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something has a quality in itself or by its own nature.

example.english: This material is not intrinsically prone to rust.
example.traditional: 呢種物料本身唔容易生鏽。
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 mat6 liu2 bun2 san1 m4 jung4 ji6 saang1 sau3

rows.note: Use this when the intrinsic quality is innate or present from birth, rather than simply belonging to the thing itself.

example.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 saang1 zau6 hou2 jau5 jam1 ngok6 gam2

rows.note: Use this more formal expression when discussing the essential nature of something in analytical or written contexts.

example.english: The issue is intrinsically a policy matter, not a technical one.
example.traditional: 本質上，呢個問題係政策問題，唔係技術問題。
example.jyutping: bun2 zat1 soeng6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hai6 zing3 caak3 man6 tai4 m4 hai6 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4
